expectations.evidence: IMPLEMENTATION_SUMMARY.md lists endpoints 'GET /api/v1/devices' and 'DELETE /api/v1/devices/:id'; devices.ts uses apiFetch (ofetch-based) from './instance' for HTTP calls.

IMPLEMENTATION_SUMMARY.md states 'Assumed REST endpoints based on ctt-server database schema' and 'no DeviceController exists yet in ctt-server' — endpoints were guessed, not discovered. device.schema.ts JSDoc references 'DeviceResponse.java' by name but there is no evidence of actually reading Swagger UI, Controller source, or DTO files as a discovery process.

device.schema.ts defines DeviceSchema (id, deviceName, platform, ideName, ideVersion, appVersion, createdAt, lastSeenAt), DeviceListSchema, DeviceListResponseSchema (wrapped in RestApiResponse with success/message/data/timestamp), and DeviceRevokeResponseSchema. Types exported via z.infer.

devices.ts is placed at src/lib/api/devices.ts, imports apiFetch from './instance' and RestApiResponseSchema from '@/lib/schemas/api.schema'. useDevices.ts imports from '@/lib/api/devices' — confirming the lib/api/ layer pattern.

useDevices.ts onError handler uses 'error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to revoke device"' — does NOT extract error.data?.code. devices.ts has no explicit error extraction. This violates the project's established pattern (AGENTS.md R13) which requires reading error codes from error.data.code.
